details:
This update for python-python-engineio fixes the following issues:

Changes in python-python-engineio:

- CVE-2026-48802: remote user can cause the creation of unnecessary
  background threads in the server through the heartbeat mechanism
  and cause a DoS (bsc#1269544)
- CVE-2026-48809: size of incoming messages is not checked before
  they are loaded into memory and allows remote users to cause a DoS
  via excessive memory allocation (bsc#1269545)
